name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TRIGGER-SELECTOR BUILD (v2, fixes configure() schema + adds load diagnostics): 0.4.36's configure() parameter schema used an unusual 'type: object, additionalProperties: true' shape with no 'properties' key -- suspected of failing Thunderbird's experiment_apis schema validation at startup, which would explain a report that neither the compose-window-open trigger nor the (unconditional) shutdown cleanup ran at all. Switches to an explicit properties list (the well-established pattern for object parameters in WebExtension schemas), and adds console.log lines confirming the script evaluated, getAPI()/initialize() ran, and each compose window's activeTriggers.windowOpen value at hook time, to pin down the failure precisely if this wasn't the actual cause.
